operator: AMTS (Amdavad Municipal Transport Service) — city bus
notes: AMTS is a bus-only operator (route_type=3); Ahmedabad Metro is a separate operator (GMRC), so the metro/rail-first guidance does not apply to this AMTS-bus feed. STOP COORDINATES: from community GitHub gnatih/AMTS stops.geojson (1450 WGS-84 stops, matched by exact + strict fuzzy/token-set), supplemented with curated OSM/Wikidata WGS-84 coords for major terminals not cleanly in the geojson (Lal Darwaja, Maninagar, Vasna, Vadaj, Kalupur, Naroda, APMC, Metro Station, etc.). 228/321 stops (71%) are geocoded; the 93 remaining are minor society/apartment/farm stops not present in the source data and are emitted WITHOUT lat/lon (unknown, not fabricated). ROUTES & ORDERED STOPS: scraped from YoMetro (yometro.com/buses/amts-*) route pages, which give full ordered stop sequences per route. 6 representative routes built end-to-end with both directions: 300 (Vadaj-Maninagar, 69 stops), 144 (Gujarat University-Arbudanagar, 51), 401 (Vasna-Chandkheda, 46), 45 (Lal Darwaja-Shela Gam, 49), 58 (Thaltej Gam-Kush Society, 91), 160 (Silver Oak University-Hatkeshwar Depo, 75). citybus.co.in had an expired TLS cert (unreachable). The gnatih/AMTS GPX folder only contains one raw GPS trace (route 300) with no stop labels, so it was not used for sequencing. TIMING: first-bus departure times are from the source; per-stop times are evenly interpolated across the published total journey time (source gives journey duration, not a per-stop timetable or headway) - clock times are realistic estimates, not the exact published timetable. Service window citywide ~05:30-22:30 daily; calendar set to daily service. CONFIDENCE 0.55: route lists and stop ordering are real and well-evidenced; stop coordinates are largely real (community + OSM/Wikidata WGS-84); intermediate stop times are interpolated and only 6 of AMTS's ~170 routes are covered, so it is a faithful sample rather than the complete network. GTFS validated: 0 orphan refs, times monotonic per trip, all coords within Ahmedabad bounds (22.8-23.3N, 72.3-72.8E). Sources: github.com/gnatih/AMTS, yometro.com/buses/amts-network, amts.co.in.
